newsitem.title: CUBA: Cubans steal from new hotel sites to build homes.
newsitem.headline: Cubans steal from new hotel sites to build homes.

text.p: Cubans are stealing building materials from hotel construction sites in the beach resort of Varadero to build private homes, official media said on Wednesday.
The ruling Communist Party newspaper Granma said that in recent months authorities had found 58 homes in the town built using materials from construction sites.
The newspaper was reporting on a meeting of the local branch of the Communist Party in Varadero, Cuba's prime tourist spot east of Havana.

The resort has some 33 hotels with a total of 8,000 beds and is expanding rapidly to meet growing demand. Granma said the Varadero meeting noted new hotels were not being completed quickly enough or to high enough standards. Party officials called for improved security to avoid "deviation of materials".

It is common knowledge among Cubans that materials are stolen from state building sites, and there is a black market in goods such as cement and tiles. But the problem is rarely discussed openly by officials.
